title: Route Decision v1
description: Frozen execution contract (SW-1510-CONTRACT). Router decision for one request, keeping requested, resolved and answering identity as separate facts. attribution_status records whether the answering model is known; 'unknown' is honest and never coerced to a definitive value, and answering_model is then the empty string. The router supplies this record; it does not become a duplicate lifecycle controller.

parent_request_id.description: Empty string for a root request, otherwise the parent request id.

requested_model.description: Alias the caller asked for; the bound provider is not silently aliased to it.

answering_model.description: Observed answering identity, or the empty string when it could not be observed. Never inferred from the request.

reservation_id.description: Reservation that funded this request. A request with no reservation is not admissible.

usage.description: Observed usage when available; usage_status='unknown' means the value is unavailable and stays reserved.
